item.description:
Ingest 0.9.9.12

Removed:

  • Ask Claude and the Apple Intelligence caption, keyword and template suggestions. Nothing about your photos is sent to an AI service. Face, eye, focus and similar-shot checks still run on your Mac.

Safer card cleanup:

  • Ingest deletes an original from the card only when its copy is still there and unchanged. If a copy went missing or an action rewrote it after import, the original stays on the card.
  • Deleting photos from a memory card always asks first, because it can’t be undone.
  • After a crash during import, the next launch removes the half-copied files it left behind.

Fixed:

  • Organize puts originals in the Trash under their own names, so Put Back restores them. On a disk with no Trash, the original stays where it was and the result says so.
  • Copy and Move now ask your workspace’s shoot questions before naming files.
  • Saving in the Workspace Builder keeps changes you made elsewhere while it was open.
  • Links that change files ask before they run.
  • Delete All on a large card no longer pauses the app while it checks the files.

Also:

  • The Help menu points to ingestphotoapp.com and adds Privacy Policy. About Ingest lists the open-source components and their licenses.

Requires macOS 15 or later and an Apple silicon Mac.

Ingest 0.9.9.11

  • When you browse during import, the destination folder opens in the current tab. Thumbnails appear as photos arrive.
  • A small progress popover opens in the bottom-right corner when an import starts. It shows how many files have been copied and verified. Click the status to reopen it at any time during the import.

Requires macOS 15 or later and an Apple silicon Mac.

Ingest 0.9.9.10

  • Fixed the Workspace menu in Import Photos. You can select any saved workspace, and a single checkmark shows which one is active.

Requires macOS 15 or later and an Apple silicon Mac.
